title: Demand Forecasting and Dynamic Pricing
story: An AI-powered smart energy system that predicts electricity demand using LSTM and generates dynamic pricing based on forecasted transformer load. Combines real-time IoT monitoring, machine learning, and intelligent pricing recommendations to improve energy efficiency and reduce overload.

title: Acta - Meeting Application
story: Acta was developed during HackXtreme'26, a 24-hour hackathon at K. Ramakrishnan College of Engineering, where it won first place. Built around a simple belief — meetings should drive progress, not paperwork — it listens, understands, and transforms discussions into organized minutes, decisions, and actionable tasks, allowing teams to focus on collaboration instead of documentation.

title: Food Bridge - Redistribution Platform
story: FoodBridge was developed during TechHacks 2.0, an international hackathon hosted by SRM Ramapuram at Genesys, Infocity, where it secured second place. It is a smart food redistribution platform designed to make food donation effortless. By bringing together donors, NGOs, volunteers, and logistics partners, it enables surplus food to be rescued quickly, efficiently, and responsibly.
